meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你管理 Git 版本历史：自动分组并提交代码、整理提交记录（变基、合并等）、通过 git blame/log 等工具查询谁在何时改了何代码，并给出带命令证据的答案。
howto.when: 当你要求进行 Git 操作（如提交、变基、查询历史）或询问代码变更历史（谁写的、什么时候加的等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交当前所有改动，用项目风格的提交信息。
say.note: Claude 会分析最近提交风格，自动分组并提交。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁写的，什么时候加的。
say.note: Claude 会使用 git blame 查找。

say.text: 我要把最近三个提交合并成一个。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Git history: stage and commit changes in atomic groups, rebase/squash commits, and answer history questions using git blame, log, bisect, etc., citing exact command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for Git operations (commit, rebase, etc.) or inquire about Git history (who wrote this, when added, etc.).

say_en.text: Commit all current changes with the project's commit style.
say_en.note: Claude detects recent commit style and groups accordingly.

say_en.text: Find who wrote this line and when it was added.
say_en.note: Claude uses git blame to inspect.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude performs rebase; asks about pushed status first.
